name: v5.0.3
body:
###    🐞 Bug Fixes

- Isolate `result.status` between `repeats` runs  -  by @hi-ogawa, **Hiroshi Ogawa** and **Codex (GPT-6)** in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11218 [<samp>(5dbeb)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/5dbebe9e3)
- Don't print an interceptor warning in browser mode  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11377 [<samp>(15cc0)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/15cc006aa)
- Don't retry when `test.fails` expectedly failed  -  by @hi-ogawa, **Hiroshi Ogawa** and **Codex (GPT-6)** in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11219 [<samp>(b2458)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/b24585f08)
- Scope cache key generators to projects  -  by @ecoyoung in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11281 and https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11301 [<samp>(92ba7)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/92ba7fc1d)
- **browser**:
  - Delay server `listen` until tests start running  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11366 [<samp>(7d8ed)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/7d8ed3e9b)
  - Check mock path boundaries  -  by @saryn17, **Ryosei Sato** and @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11361 and https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11362 [<samp>(1c388)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/1c3888bce)
  - Keep config of browser-consumed environments  -  by @kasperpeulen and **Claude** in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11378 [<samp>(aafc0)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/aafc0996f)
  - Ignore page crash while cancelling  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11386 [<samp>(7c367)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/7c36748fa)
  - `toMatchScreenshot` uses wrong reference on retried tests  -  by @macarie in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11393 [<samp>(c22ab)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/c22aba992)
- **cache**:
  - Revalidate imports of cached modules  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11381 [<samp>(38f98)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/38f98855f)
- **deps**:
  - Pin `why-is-node-running` to `3.2.1` to avoid users running into `ERR_PNPM_TRUST_DOWNGRADE`  -  by @AriPerkkio in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11403 [<samp>(f6c9a)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/f6c9a4977)
- **expect**:
  - Pass current equality testers to `expect.extend` asymmetric matchers  -  by @hi-ogawa, **Hiroshi Ogawa** and **Claude** in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11401 [<samp>(3e794)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/3e794a96b)
- **jsdom**:
  - Support Blob on jsdom 30.1  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11379 [<samp>(6c49b)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/6c49b7197)
- **pool**:
  - Preserve unique pool ids when `groupOrder` is set  -  by @mtorp in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11392 [<samp>(50312)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/50312ebb4)
- **ui**:
  - Split-pane handle overlapping iframe  -  by @macarie in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11221 [<samp>(f91db)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/f91db0dfd)
- **vitest**:
  - Remove root temp dir on close  -  by @abhinav-phi in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11248 [<samp>(7c711)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/7c7119cf7)
- **vm**:
  - Do not optimize deps from index.html  -  by @ezefernandezyf, **Hiroshi Ogawa** and **Codex (GPT-6)** in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11329 and https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11360 [<samp>(caf28)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/caf2887de)
  - Don't reuse scripts across vite environments  -  by @MO2k4, **Martin Oehlert** and **Claude** in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11395 [<samp>(346d3)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/346d3896b)

#####     [View changes on GitHub](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/compare/v5.0.2...v5.0.3)
